{{Quote|Destination, please.|The air taxi driver droid|<ref name="Deceived" />}}
A '''droid''' worked as an [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] [[Pilot droid/Legends|driver]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the time of [[Alderaan peace conference|peace negotiations]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] on the planet<ref name="Deceived" /> in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' to [[3653 BBY]].</ref> It wore a cloth [[Hat/Legends|hat]], aiming to look more [[Human/Legends|Human]] by donning it, and also had an integrated [[card scanner]] in its [[Limb/Legends|hand]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Pilot/Legends|drove]] rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] to the [[Eeseen spaceport]] while she was on her way to avenge the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Ven Zallow]]. Though it tried to initiate its social [[Programmer/Legends|programming]] and make small talk, Leneer told the droid that she wanted to ride in silence. The droid sped up the air taxi as they moved into a higher altitude used for commercial travel. Once they arrived at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the droid held out its integrated card scanner so she could pay. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] quickly used her [[credcard]] before departing.<ref name="Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The air taxi driver droid appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]].<ref name="Deceived" />
